title: Learning New Facts with QLoRA: An Acquisition-Retention Frontier
abstract: arXiv:2608.25677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning is often assumed to preserve pretrained capabilities because it updates only a small number of parameters. We show that this assumption depends strongly on adapter capacity. We study factual acquisition in a controlled OpenStreetMap-derived benchmark where Qwen3-4B must acquire anonymized geographic associations while retaining unrelated capabilities. Comparing full fine-tuning (FFT) with quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) at ranks 8, 16, 32, and 64, we find that rank induces a clear acquisition--retention frontier. Low-rank QLoRA preserves out-of-domain (OOD) performance but acquires fewer facts, whereas higher ranks improve same-fact paraphrase generalization at an increasing cost in performance on unrelated benchmarks. FFT behaves as a conservative baseline: it retains general capabilities well, but does not reach the highest factual-acquisition regime. Distributional, weight-space, and spectral diag

translated_title: 使用QLoRA学习新事实：获取-保留边界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25677v1 公告类型：新  摘要：参数高效微调通常被认为能保留预训练能力，因为它仅更新少量参数。我们表明，这一假设在很大程度上依赖于适配器的容量。我们在一个受控的、基于OpenStreetMap的基准测试中研究了事实获取，其中Qwen3-4B必须获取匿名的地理关联，同时保留无关的能力。通过将全量微调（FFT）与量化低秩适配（QLoRA）在秩为8、16、32和64的情况下进行比较，我们发现秩引出了一个清晰的获取-保留边界。低秩QLoRA保留了域外（OOD）性能，但获取的事实较少，而较高秩提高了同事实释义的泛化能力，但以在无关基准上性能下降为代价。FFT表现为一个保守的基线：它很好地保留了通用能力，但未达到最高的事实获取状态。分布、权重空间和谱诊断...
tldr: 本文通过系统比较不同秩的QLoRA与全量微调，揭示了参数高效微调中秩的选择在事实获取与能力保留之间存在明确的权衡边界，其中低秩保留能力但获取少，高秩获取多但损失能力，全量微调则作为保守基线。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares QLoRA at various ranks with full fine-tuning, revealing a clear acquisition-retention frontier where low ranks preserve capabilities but acquire fewer facts, high ranks acquire more at a cost, and full fine-tuning serves as a conservative baseline.
